information.annual: current state, announced trajectories, committed projects; no future realised event
information.event: same day (24 h) perfect operational forecast for all; no future-day forecast

h01.fixed_mode: same_initial_committed_generation_project_set; clean-project commissioning delayed by L; paid terminal renewals still follow vE

assumption_basis.event: 12 days bounds compute and includes 2 pre-event, 4 shock, 2 recovery and post-event time. Six-hour steps inherit the four-period Q2 shape; no empirical frequency. Selection/test offsets fixed before outputs.
assumption_basis.SP_ST: 1.5 carbon and 0.7 new-storage costs are bounded conditional contrasts, not projections or government choices of free innovation. Sensitivities at alternative values.
assumption_basis.h01: 0–4% of initial coal MW voluntary early-retirement requests, eligible renewal electric shares 0–0.5, and 0–3 extra construction years are stress probes; not inferred national behaviour. No legal lifetime extension.
assumption_basis.policy: Fractional additions below inherited construction envelopes; additional public funding ceiling 0.05% GDP and gas contract cost are hypotheses. Cost bounds and held-out shocks are reported, not adapted for feasibility.
assumption_basis.service_limits: 2% trigger, 5% annual/15% event limits are normative screening thresholds for proxy services, not legal reliability criteria. All infeasible candidates retained.

revision_disclosure: V1 test offset -2 violated the required two-day prehistory. Replaced only the invalid test calendar with offsets +2,+3 before any held-out event execution; +3 intentionally tests endpoint censoring. No shock magnitude, policy, selection threshold or selection sample changed. Fixed-project control now replays the S0 request schedule with original finance checks; it no longer disables all investment. V3: repair duplicate scope keyword in report assembly; shard ledgers under Git size limit; strengthen replacement-ready comparator with actual available-device dispatch; fixed-mode generation project set is the identical initial committed queue (no new generation/grid proposals), while terminal replacement remains active. Ranking rounds numerical ties; terminal valuation includes paid devices and work-in-progress. All thresholds and event magnitudes unchanged; previously executed test cases are acknowledged as reused for implementation repairs.
